hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { command -v poetry >/dev/null 2>&1 && find . -name '*.py' -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './.*' | grep -q . && poetry run pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5 || echo '[harness] pytest skipped (bootstrap: no source code or poetry not installed yet)'; }

INPUT=$(cat); ACTIVE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | tr -d '\000-\037' | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ "$ACTIVE" = "true" ] && exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; STATUS=$(jq -r '.status // "idle"' progress/active.json 2>/dev/null || echo idle); if ./init.sh > /tmp/rjp_harness_init.log 2>&1; then echo '[harness] init.sh OK'; exit 0; fi; case "$STATUS" in in_progress*) echo '[harness] gate RED — expected mid-implementation (status '"$STATUS"'); see /tmp/rjp_harness_init.log'; exit 0;; esac; echo '[harness] init.sh FAILED — see /tmp/rjp_harness_init.log'; tail -20 /tmp/rjp_harness_init.log; exit 2
